data.value: Manage identified service instances and platform capacity.

data.name: 正式遙測接收尚未完成；此處不代表服務健康狀態。
data.value: Production telemetry reception is not yet complete; this page does not indicate service health.

data.name: 無法讀取資料，請重新整理後再試。
data.value: Unable to load data. Refresh and try again.

data.name: 包含已退役的執行個體。降低上限不會刪除既有資料；達到上限時不再新增身分，既有身分仍可辨識。
data.value: Retired instances are included. Lowering the limit does not delete existing data. At the limit, no new identities are added, but existing identities remain recognizable.

data.name: 服務停收後不再授權接收新資料；恢復後只接受新授權期間的資料。
data.value: Stopping collection revokes authorization for new data. After resuming, only data from the newly authorized period is accepted.

data.name: 此頁沒有已加入的服務。
data.value: There are no enrolled services on this page.

data.name: 停止後立即拒絕此服務的新資料，並保留既有資料。
data.value: Stopping immediately rejects new data for this service and retains existing data.

data.name: 恢復只接受新授權期間的資料，來源必須仍可使用。
data.value: Resuming accepts data only from the new authorization period; the source must remain available.

data.name: 封存會停止收集並撤回公開，保留服務身分和歷史資料。
data.value: Archiving stops collection and removes public access while retaining the service identity and history.

data.name: 恢復後仍為私人且停止收集；如有需要，請再手動恢復收集與公開設定。
data.value: After restoration the service remains private and collection remains stopped; resume collection and public access manually if needed.

data.name: 退役後不會自動恢復；恢復保留原本的執行個體識別碼，也不會改變服務收集設定。
data.value: Retired instances are not automatically restored. Restoring preserves the instance ID and does not change the service collection settings.

data.name: 此頁沒有執行個體。
data.value: There are no instances on this page.
